notes: S3-FIX2 (decision 2026-11-18 #2), S3-FIX2/N1d: a valid zip container also holds the entry readable/x, deflated from zero bytes (two compressed bytes, uncompressed size 0), which carries the DOS directory attribute (0x10). An entry carries data when its compressed or uncompressed size is not zero, the same test as for a name ending '/', so this is E_CONTAINER_ZIP (§11.9 rule 4, checked for readable/ entries too). The Python reference verifier looked at the uncompressed size only and accepted this zip before the fix.
